subject: Red Knight
text: A Red Knight walking around two open rooms in Brecconary asks if you are the descendant of Erdrick.

evidence.quote: There are two rooms ahead and there doors are open. Talk to the Red Knight walking around the rooms first, and he'll ask you, "Art thou the descendant of Erdrick? Hast thou any proof?"

subject: Man in leftmost room
text: A man in the leftmost room of Brecconary states that magic keys can be purchased in another town.

evidence.quote: Then enter the leftmost room and talk to the man there. He'll let you know that, "There is a town where magic keys can be purchased."

subject: Old man in rightmost room
text: An old man in the rightmost room of Brecconary will heal you if you become cursed from equipping cursed items.

evidence.quote: The old man in the rightmost room will tell you, "If thou art cursed, come again." He will heal you if you are cursed for some reason. (Farther in the game you'll come across cursed items. If you equip them on you, you will be cursed and you'll have to talk to him to get uncursed.)

subject: Wandering guard
text: A wandering guard near the northeast building in Brecconary recommends visiting King Lorik after gaining experience levels.

evidence.quote: Finally, go up to the building in the northeast corner of the town. Talk to the wandering guard there and he'll recommend that you, "See King Lorik when thy experience levels are raised."

subject: Bridges
text: Enemies on the world map become stronger when you cross bridges.

evidence.quote: Also there for you to talk to is a Red Knight in the northeast most corner of the town, and he isn't moving. Talk to him. He'll give you an excellent warning. "Beware the bridges! Danger grows when thou crosses." In otherwords, when you cross a bridge on the world map, the enemies get stronger.

subject: Leather Armor
text: Leather Armor can be purchased at the Brecconary shop for 70 Gold.

evidence.quote: Leather Armor (70 Gold)

subject: Small Shield
text: A Small Shield can be purchased at the Brecconary shop for 90 Gold.

evidence.quote: Small Shield (90 Gold)

subject: Copper Sword
text: A Copper Sword can be purchased at the Brecconary shop for 180 Gold.

evidence.quote: Copper Sword (180 Gold)

subject: Slimes and Drakees
text: Slimes and Drakees can be fought in the area surrounding Tantagel Castle and Brecconary.

evidence.quote: Initially, until you reach level 3, you should fight Slimes and a few Drakees around the Tantagel Castle/Brecconary area.

subject: Heal
text: The Heal spell is learned upon reaching Level 3.

evidence.quote: Level 3 introduces to you the first spell you can use in the game, Heal, so that will also help you to save some money (although you can only use it once on Level 3 before running out of Magic Points).

subject: Magician
text: You should flee from Magicians until reaching Level 4 or higher.

evidence.quote: If you run into a Magician and you're not level 4 or higher, RUN AWAY!!!

subject: Hurt
text: The damage spell Hurt is learned upon reaching Level 4.

evidence.quote: Once you hit Level 4, you'll learn Hurt, and you can lay the smackdown on the Magicians now.

subject: Clothes
text: The shopkeeper in Brecconary buys Clothes for 10 Gold.

evidence.quote: Buy the Leather Armor for 70 gold, and the shopkeeper will buy your Clothes for 10 Gold.

subject: Club
text: The shopkeeper in Brecconary buys the Club back for 30 Gold.

evidence.quote: Also, purchase the Small Shield and purchase the Copper Sword, and the shopkeeper will buy back the Club for 30 Gold.

subject: Slimes and Red Slimes
text: Slimes and Red Slimes begin running away in battle as your character grows much stronger.

evidence.quote: Slimes and Red Slimes are starting to run away in battle (this means you're getting very strong)

subject: Erdrick's Cave
text: Erdrick's Cave is the only dungeon in the game that contains no enemies.

evidence.quote: Erdick's Cave should not be a challenge for you. This is the only cave/dungeon in the game with no enemies, so enjoy it while it lasts.

subject: Erdrick's Cave B1F
text: From the entrance of Erdrick's Cave, navigate right one, down six, left one, down two, right six, up one, right two, down three, right two, down two to reach the stairs.

evidence.quote: First, go right one, and then down six. Then go left one, down two, right six, up one, right two, down three, right two, down two, and up the stairs.

subject: Treasure Chest
text: Navigate right one, up five, left three, down four, left two, up one, left one, up one, left three, up three, right three, up three, left three, up two, right six, down four, right three to find the chest containing Erdrick's Tablet.

evidence.quote: Now, go right one, up five, left three, down four, left two, up one, left one, up one, left three, up three, right three, up three, left three, up two, right six, down four, right three, to the treasure chest. Open it and retrieve the tablet.

subject: Erdrick's Tablet
text: Erdrick's Tablet reveals that three items needed to reach the Isle of Dragons south of Brecconary have been entrusted to three keepers.

evidence.quote: "I am Erdrick and thou art my descendant. Three items were needed to reach the Isle of Dragons which is south of Brecconary. I gathered these items, reached the island, and there defeated a creature of great evil. Now I have entrusted the three items to three worthy keepers. Their descendants will protect the items until thy quest leads thee to seek them out. When a new evil arises, find the three items, then fight!"

subject: Garinham
text: The town of Garinham is located in the northwest corner of the continent.

evidence.quote: Once outside on the world map, work your way up and left to the town in the northwest corner, the town of Garinham.

subject: Inn
text: Staying at the Inn in Garinham costs 25 gold.

evidence.quote: INN – 25 gold

subject: Club
text: A Club can be bought at Garinham's weapon shop for 60 gold and grants +4 attack power.

evidence.quote: Club – 60 gold (+4)

subject: Old man
text: An old man in Garinham shares that Garin, a legendary minstrel, built the town.

evidence.quote: Right off the bat, go up and talk to the old man, who'll say, "Garin, a wandering minstrel of legendary fame, is said to have built this town."

subject: Stationary old man
text: A stationary old man in Garinham says many believe Princess Gwaelin is hidden away in a cave.

evidence.quote: then go down across and talk to the stationary old man there. He'll say, "Many believe that Princess Gwaelin is hidden away in a cave."

subject: Red Knight
text: A Red Knight in Garinham asks if you know someone named Nester.

evidence.quote: Then go right and talk to the Red Knight, who'll ask you, "I've heard of one named Nester. Dost thou know such a one?"

subject: Blue-haired man
text: A blue-haired man in Garinham reveals that Princess Gwaelin was kidnapped and taken eastward.

evidence.quote: The blue-haired man'll say, "It is said that the Princess was kidnapped and taken eastward."

subject: Bridge south of Garinham
text: Magidrakees, Scorpions, and Skeletons appear across the bridge located south of Garinham.

evidence.quote: To the south of Garinham is a bridge that you should cross over. Across this bridge are very powerful enemies; Magidrakees, Scorpions, and even Skeletons.

subject: Old man behind desk
text: Talking to the old man behind the desk in the southeast corner of Tantagel Castle restores your MP to maximum.

evidence.quote: you can go to the castle and talk to the old man in the southeast corner behind the desk. He'll say something to you, but after you talk to him, your MP will be maxed out.

subject: Fairy Flute
text: In Kol, walk four blocks down from the one-block waterhole at the top of town and search to find the Fairy Flute.

evidence.quote: Go up to the one-block big waterhole at the top of town. Walk down from it four blocks. Then use the search command to get the Fairy Flute.

subject: Red Knight in weapon shop
text: A Red Knight inside the Kol weapon shop mentions that extraordinary weapons can be bought in a town east of Hauksness.

evidence.quote: Up a tad bit more, go right and into the weapon shop, and talk to the Red Knight here. He'll say, "East of Hauksness there is a town, 'tis said, where one may purchase weapons of extraordinary quality."

subject: Golem
text: A wandering old man outside the weapon shop in Kol explains that fairies know how to put Golem to sleep.

evidence.quote: The wandering old man outside of the weapons shop says, "In legends, it is said that fairies know how to put Golem to sleep." (in otherwords, that's what we're using the recently acquired Fairy Flute for. =P)

subject: Wandering green man
text: A wandering green man in Kol reveals that the town of Rimuldar lies to the south.

evidence.quote: Then talk to the wandering green man, he'll ask you, "Hast thou been to the southern island?" You can answer "yes" or "no". If you answer "no" he'll say, "To the south, I believe, there is a town called Rimuldar."

subject: Southwestern guard
text: A guard in the southwestern corner of Kol reveals that Rimuldar is the place where keys can be bought.

evidence.quote: Around that same area in the southwestern corner of the town is a guard. Talk to him (he's not moving), and he'll say, "Rimuldar is the place to buy keys."

subject: Radiant
text: The spell Radiant is learned upon reaching Level 9 and illuminates a larger radius than a torch.

evidence.quote: It's vital to be at level 9 because this is when you learn the spell Radiant, which has the same effect as a torch. Using a few MP, Radiant lights a radius around the character so he can see in dark caves and dungeons, and, as a matter of fact, Radiant actually lights up a greater area than the torch.

subject: Rock Mountain Cave
text: From the bridge south of Garinham, head south to the bottom, go right, and take the top route where mountains split the path to enter Rock Mountain Cave.

evidence.quote: Okay, from the bridge, head south, fighting enemies as you go. When you reach the bottom, go right, and then when the path branches into two areas, cut in half by some mountains, take the top route and enter the cave. This is Rock Mountain Cave

subject: Rock Mountain Cave
text: The Fighter's Ring is found inside Rock Mountain Cave.

evidence.quote: This is Rock Mountain Cave, and you should definitely get the Fighter's Ring while we're here, it's the only reason we're here, actually. =)
